# Rakuten Melbourne Engineer Code Test D
* Your main objective is to extract an Order and its details from each HTML file in the `./orders` folder.
* The extracted data should match the structure and data of the Order object defined in `test.js`.
* Edit `extract_order.js` to implement your solution.
* Using an AI coding assistant is required for this exercise. See "Using AI tools" below.
* Do not create new files, other than `AI_USAGE.md` and the reusable workflow artifact described below.
* Do not edit the test file or the provided HTML.

## Steps
* Edit extract_order.js to extract order details
* Run `./test` in your local environment to run the test.
* Your submission must pass the test.

## Using AI tools
Using an AI coding assistant (Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT, etc.) for this exercise is **required**, not optional. We're not only assessing whether you can produce a correct `extract_order.js` but also how you work with an AI tool: whether you direct it well, catch what it gets wrong, and understand the code you end up submitting well enough to explain, defend, and adapt it, regardless of how it was produced.

A couple of things to keep in mind:
* Add a required `AI_USAGE.md` alongside your solution covering: which tool(s) you used, the prompts/approach you took, and, most importantly, what you had to correct, verify, or reject from the AI's output and why. A submission with no `AI_USAGE.md`, or one that shows no evidence of actual AI-assisted work, will be treated as incomplete.
* Don't stop at a one-off chat transcript. Package what you learned solving this page into something reusable (a prompt template, a checklist, or an actual reusable skill/command) that someone could point at a *different* but similarly-structured e-commerce order confirmation page and get a head start. Include it as a "Reusable workflow" section in `AI_USAGE.md`, or as its own file/folder if that fits the format better. We're looking for evidence you generalized the approach, not just that you solved this one page.
* Be ready to walk through your solution and reasoning live, including the parts an AI tool wrote.

## Submission
Please submit your code test in a public GitHub repo and notify dennis.hou@rakuten.com when you are done!
